You: Traditionally this type of skirt was longer, right? Maybe clashing tradition with futurism is the way?
#Annalie.Eyes.normal+Annalie.Mouth.surprised
Lady Annalie: I think your problem is that you think too much. {{wi}}Or maybe at all. Whatever the case, just stop.
#Annalie.Eyes.surprised+Annalie.Mouth.smile
Lady Annalie: We will go with the shorter one.
